rationale: Register the usable initial map and investigate the sourced automatic-exit continuation premise without presuming violation.

question.question: Can a legally applied implicit joint configuration remain without an automatic exit proposal after application completion attempts exit during leadership transfer, transfer later aborts, and no further application work is pending?
question.importance: A missed automatic exit can retain outgoing voters and obstruct subsequent membership changes or intended availability. No consensus safety violation is presumed.
contexts: Transfer blocks proposal at application completion; same leader survives timeout
event_paths: Committed joint entry -> ApplyConfChange -> transfer starts -> application acknowledgment -> rejected automatic exit -> transfer cancellation -> continued ticks and message processing

supporting_behavior_ids.B-transfer: Controls proposal eligibility during completion and cancellation.
supporting_behavior_ids.B-replicate: Forms and commits the joint entry and any eventual exit entry.
supporting_behavior_ids.B-authority: New leadership supplies an alternative future application trigger.

counterevidence: appliedTo retries on subsequent application; a successful new leader appends an entry whose application can trigger exit.
Transfer timeout clears proposal blocking. Joint configuration itself remains a valid quorum arrangement.
unknowns: Construct a legal public-interface schedule that enters joint state, overlaps transfer and application acknowledgment, and drains all owed work.
Determine whether any remaining retry, heartbeat, storage response or caller duty causes automatic exit after cancellation without new application proposals.
Separate finite non-completion from a closed repeatable continuation failure; automatic contract has no numeric deadline.
question.trigger_rationale: The implementation promises automatic transition when possible, but timeout only clears leadTransferee and empty Ready/Advance does not call appliedTo. Source reading narrows the discriminator to legal overlap and remaining triggers; a small exploration is more informative than broad variant testing.

feedback.answered: Advance only invokes appliedTo through nonempty committed-entry or snapshot completion. Transfer timeout only clears the target. AutoLeave is assigned to Raft when possible. A later application or new leader remains a possible continuation; whether either is required in the selected history remains open.
